Day-by-Day Schedule

Complete Tour Itinerary

Our itineraries are fully customizable. Your private chauffeur will drive at your desired pace.

1
Day 1

Day 1: Arrival & Historic Royal Palaces Tour

Meet your private chauffeur upon arrival at Udaipur Airport / Railway Station or your hotel. Start your royal tour with the majestic City Palace, visit the 17th-century Jagdish Temple, and enjoy a picturesque boat ride on Lake Pichola with views of Jag Mandir. In the evening, witness the cultural folk performance at Bagore Ki Haveli.

Key Highlights & Stops:
City PalaceJagdish TempleLake PicholaBagore Ki HaveliGangaur Ghat
2
Day 2

Day 2: Royal Gardens, Scenic Lakes & Sunset Departure

After breakfast, proceed to visit the exquisite Saheliyon-Ki-Bari royal garden. Drive along the scenic banks of Fateh Sagar Lake, visit Moti Magri memorial, and ascend to the Monsoon Palace (Sajjangarh) for breathtaking panoramic valley views. Explore local handicraft markets before a smooth transfer to your departure point.

Key Highlights & Stops:
Saheliyon Ki BariFateh Sagar LakeMoti MagriMonsoon Palace (Sajjangarh)Bapu Bazaar
